description: Save a handler that runs on every event this app receives, in an isolated sandbox, with AnyHook's retries and replay around it: no server of your own. Each run's console output and return value are stored as that delivery's response (anyhook_inspect shows them). It can also run on a cron schedule. Pro and Scale; runs are capped per month. Test it with anyhook_code_test before real events arrive.

api_key.description: API key (ahk_live_...) from anyhook_quickstart. Only needed over HTTP when no Authorization header is set; ignored over stdio.

appSlug.description: The app whose events the code runs on.

code.description: An ES module, run in a sandboxed Node.js on every event this app receives. Either `export default async function (event, { env }) {}` (event: { method, headers, body, raw_body, delivery_id, attempt }) or a Pipedream code step as written: `export default defineComponent({ async run({ steps, $ }) {} })` with steps.trigger.event, $.export and $.flow.exit. npm packages it imports are installed on deploy (pin as "pkg@1.2.3", like Pipedream; a new package list takes up to a minute). @pipedream/platform is a stand-in. State between events: the app's store (store.get/set/has/delete/keys, set takes { ttl }); a step's data_store prop is the same store, an app prop's this.<prop>.$auth.<field> reads the secret <APP>_<FIELD>, any other prop the secret named after it (channelId → CHANNEL_ID). Throwing fails the delivery, which AnyHook retries. Templates for common actions (Slack, email, Google Sheets, Notion, Claude and more): https://anyhook.net/code-templates.md

enabled.description: Whether events run the code. false saves it switched off, so it runs only through anyhook_code_test. Omit: a first deploy goes live and later deploys keep the current state. Deploy off while another system still handles the same events, or both will act on each one.

schedule.description: Also run on a cron schedule: five fields, UTC unless prefixed CRON_TZ=Area/City, e.g. "*/15 * * * *". Each firing arrives as an anyhook.schedule event and counts as a run. null removes it; omit to keep it. Only on an app that does not verify a sender's signature.

secrets.description: Environment variables for the code, read as env.NAME or process.env.NAME. Merged into the saved ones; null removes a name.

name: anyhook_code_deploy
title: Deploy code that runs on an app's events
